I'm just going to merge this as-is. Everyone and their grandma has an opinion about argon, so I don't think any discussion here about aesthetics is going to be productive. This PR does the job of disabling hit lighting; the rest can follow from there if we figure out how to get a clear direction out of a thousand differing subjective opinions.

issue_context.title: argon skin hit lighting should toggle with setting
issue_context.body: When it was implemented the lighting was implemented local to the judgement results, but this at very least needs to account for the user's "hit lighting" setting.

review_comments: The thing that makes me doubt is the persistence of the *"after circle"*. This is the line that needs to be tweaked. After playing with it for a while, I've found a sweet spot with `fade_out_time / 2.75` that makes the animation the least persistent possible but keeps the "bounciness" of the animation.

I'm not willing to go that far sorry. That is not related to hit lighting.

If you want a faster animation, wait for further skin customisation setting to come online.
